svg.text: Who works for whom, and how they deal
Two questions place every way to build: does the other party work for itself or for you,
and do you get there by competing or by cooperating?
You trade trust in the counterparty
Principals entangled in a common interest
You trade a higher share of the benefits
acting as checks on each other
You trade accountability for a mild
Design with an agent, build with a principal
it has the most leverage, competition
Profits = Margin × Velocity: velocity fades, and the Principal returns to the hungry parties
Off the grid: self-performance, where the Principal and the Agent are one person.
Design-Build lands in two squares: a lump sum keeps it Principal to Principal; cost plus makes it Principal to Agent.
The diagonal runs from cheap and stressful to peaceful and expensive; the centre square balances both axes.
